mbrolaVoices.terms: Voice data limited to use with MBROLA. Free distribution requires its notice; incorporation into a sold product requires owner permission. Engine and voice data have separate terms. No voice binary downloaded, executed or redistributed.

voices.limitations: Source lists five vowels and says diphthongs and some Sefaradi accent consonants are absent. Its broad source accent label does not establish any Kinnor Accent preset.
Source lists SAMPA-like vowels and four diphthongs but explicitly excludes Sephardic guttural distinctions; it does not establish the six historical Kinnor styles.

phoneticMamIpa.scope: One literal IPA proposal over87named categories,19with source questions; source table is not parameterized by the two text dialects. Twentieth geminate category tsadi has no literal repeated half and stays withheld for split parts. This is documentary evidence, not a reviewed IPA grammar or singing voice.

nextEvidence: A qualified reader must resolve the explicit source IPA questions and syllable/segment underlay.
A reusable singing voice must cover the required vowels, diphthongs and gutturals with usage rights, plus reviewed coarticulation and duration/F0 control.
Each historical Kinnor pronunciation needs a complete source-based phonological specification and matched reviewed examples; menu labels and isolated examples are insufficient.
